programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Naesosa Temple, One Thousand Years of History
programme.desc: Legend has it that a tiger built Daeungbojeon Hall of Naesosa Temple and a blue bird painted the dancheong patterns on the building.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Interesting Sculptures of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple
programme.desc: There is an interesting legend about the unique statues of a naked woman that prop up the eaves of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple on Ganghwado Island. It is said that a carpenter who participated in the construction of the hall fell in love with a woman and that he made these statues to punish her or to cleanse her soul of sin after she betrayed his love.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Songgwangsa Temple - A Buddhist Retreat for Spiritual Quest
programme.desc: Songgwangsa, one of the three most treasured Buddhist temples of Korea, is known particularly for the largest collection of cultural heritage resources.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Hwaeomsa Temple and Its Founder's Filial Piety
programme.desc: On a hill behind Hwaeomsa Temple in Jirisan Mountain stands the Three-Story Four-Lion Stone Pagoda(National Treasure No.35). The four lions of the pagoda look very impressive while the gorgeous shapes of the celestial maids inscribed on the pedestal and the main body of the pagoda display the artistic skills of Unified Silla.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Monk Stupa of Yeongoksa Temple, a Representation of Heaven
programme.desc: Yeongoksa, the Buddhist temple located in Jirisan Mountain, is renowned for practicing Seon, and there are many monk stupas commemorating Buddhist monks who reached the high status of self-discipline.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Fragrance of home emanating from the houses of the temple, Seonam Temple, Suncheon
programme.desc: Let's encounter the Seonam Temple, the millennium-old-year temple whose faded dancheong, or traditional multicolored paintwork on the wooden building and pillars give off ambient chicness and cozy personality with snugness given by wild wood surrounding it embraced.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A repository of treasures encountered in autumn, Cheongdo Unmunsa Temple
programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: A Treasure Left by Sakyamuni, Geumgang Gyedan in Tongdosa Temple
programme.desc: Tongdosa where there are the relics of the Buddha is called Bulbosachal (Buddha-jewel monastery), Haeinsa where there is Plaman daejanggyeong that contains the words of the Buddha is called Beopbosachal (dharma-jewel monastery), and Songwangsa that has produced many great priests is called Seungbosachal (sangha-jewel monastery).

programme.desc: Executive Board of the United Nations Development Programme, the United Nations Population Fund and the United Nations Office for Project Services - Economic and Social Council, Annual Session 2025 (8-11 June 2026).

programme.title: Care, Knowledge, and Rights: Advancing the Leadership of Indigenous Persons with Disabilities'(COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: This side event will place care at the center of disability and development agendas and will mark an important milestone: the launch of the Global Network of Indigenous Persons with Disabilities, aimed at strengthening their leadership, visibility, and global advocacy.

programme.title: Synergy Between Two Movements: Paralympic Sport and Disability (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: The side event will not only provide an opportunity to showcase progress and experiences, but also to reaffirm commitments, align priorities, and strengthen recognition of Paralympic sport as a strategic ally of the international human rights system, at a key moment for the evaluation and future projection of the Convention.

programme.title: The situation in Afghanistan - Security Council, 10165th meeting
programme.desc: The situation in Afghanistan

programme.title: (Part 1) Civil Society Forum under the auspices of the 19th Session of the Conference of States Parties to the UN CRPD (COSP19)
programme.desc: The Civil Society Forum being held under the auspices of the 19th Conference of States Parties (CoSP) to the CRPD will aim to provide a space for civil society to share its initiatives, projects and concerns, including sharing experiences of Organizations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs) on the implementation of the CRPD

programme.title: Preventing and Combating Illicit Trafficking in Wildlife and other Crimes that Affect the Environment - High-level debate, General Assembly, 80th session
programme.desc: The high-level debate will raise awareness on the scale and complexity of crimes that affect the environment, and their impact on security, sustainable development and human rights. The meeting will offer a platform to reiterate the strategic importance of preventing and combating this type of crime, to share information on their trends and exchange good practice in responding to them. The meeting will also contribute to addressing the relationship between crimes that affect the environment and corruption.

programme.title: Highlights & Featured Content
programme.desc: Highlights of previous meetings and conferences, alongside pre-recorded curated videos from UN agencies showcasing the work of the UN in the field.

programme.title: From disability card to disability management information systems for inclusive social protection, care and support (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: The event, organized by UNICEF, will launch the public consultation on the global roadmap and bring it into dialogue with country practice. It will explore how countries can move from disability cards and stand-alone certification toward more functional, interoperable and rights-aligned disability management information systems that support referrals, case management, planning and inclusive service delivery.

programme.title: Disability and Digital Transformation – Ensuring Equitable Digital Future (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: In line with the theme of the 19th session of the COSP, “CRPD at 20: celebrating and consolidating achievements and shaping the next phase of implementation in a changing world,” the Korean disability community jointly organize a side event on digital transformation, as part of the collaborative activities of the SDG10 (Disability) Sub‑Committee under Development Alliance Korea (DAK), whose secretariat is operated by the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA). The event aims at reflecting on the achievements of the CRPD over the past two decades while also examining emerging global challenges and opportunities in a rapidly changing world.

programme.title: CRPD at 20: Its Evolving Impact on Other International Human Rights Instruments (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: As the CRPD marks its 20th anniversary, this side event will explore the evolving impact of the CRPD on the international human rights architecture. It will examine how other human rights instruments are increasingly interpreted in light of the CRPD.

programme.title: Protecting People and the Planet: Innovative approaches in Addressing Crimes that Affect the Environment
programme.desc: High-level side event titled “Protecting People and the Planet: Innovative approaches in addressing Crimes that Affect the Environment”, organized by UNODC in the margins of the UN General Assembly High-level Debate on “Preventing and Combating Illicit Trafficking in Wildlife and other Crimes that Affect the Environment” (A/RES/80/229).

programme.title: Civil Society Dialogue with Ambassador Leonor Zalabata Torres, Permanent Representative of Colombia
programme.desc: A dialogue between civil society representatives and the UN Security Council President for June, Leonor Zalabata Torres, Permanent Representative of Colombia to the United Nations.

programme.title: Regional Leadership in Integrated Care: Innovations from Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and the Arab States (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: This COSP19 side event, organized by the World Bank Group and the Government of Saudi Arabia, with support from UNICEF, Egypt, the League of Arab States, and civil society, explores how countries can build integrated care ecosystems that uphold the rights of persons with disabilities across the life course.

programme.title: From Education to Economic Participation: Redesigning Transition Pathways for Persons with Disabilities in the Era of Artificial Intelligence (COSP19 Side Event)
programme.desc: This side event proposes a shift in approach, the core premise is that the challenge is no longer to prepare persons with disabilities to adapt to existing systems, but rather to redesign systems to accommodate diverse human capabilities.

programme.title: Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe: A land of myriad climates and terrains, within whose boundaries lie some of the most complex and beautiful habitats on the planet. This is Europe wild and thriving.

programme.title: Crocodile Kingdom
programme.desc: The crocodile is king of the wetland a tone of cold blooded monster with the most terrifying bite force on Earth. The product of a 100 million year ancestry, the 25 species around today are testament to the crocodile's supreme intelligence and adaptability.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Jaguar
programme.desc: One of the most powerful yet elusive animals on the planet, we follow one male to reveal the secret life of the jaguar.

programme.title: Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: There are few places on the planet more magical than the forest. To spend a day here is nature's way of offering a spa, a bathe in nature. There is enchantment at every turn.

programme.title: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Breaking off from mainland Africa 160 million years ago, refugee animals cast adrift on natural rafts arrived on the tropical shores of Madagascar.

programme.title: Thermal Rampage
programme.desc: Keith Warren and his daughter meet up with Team Swamp Stomp for a Texas hog hunt in the dead of night using some killer Pulsar thermal scopes! Joining them is Garrett Streitz of APF, who decks out the team with some top-notch .308 Caliber AR-10s for the carnage!

programme.title: It’s Like Candy for Pike
programme.desc: Today’s destination is Cree Lake in Northern Saskatchewan. When the bite slows, how do you entice the giants? Check out this finesse presentation that always works time and time again on the inactive brutes

programme.title: Deep in The Skinny
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Chennaux reunites with old fishing buddy to put the new Towee Skiff to the test. Shallow water redfish beware!

programme.title: Nackawic & Crabbe Mountain Inn
programme.desc: The town of Nackawic is an exceptional ATV Hero as they allow the crossing of the St. John River to connect the southern and northern parts of New Brunswick. Many towns could learn from the welcoming nature of this town. We then head to an ATV friendly Inn to further explore the area

programme.title: The Icebox
programme.desc: Northern Manitoba holds some of the biggest lake trout on the planet. Guides from Bakers Narrows Lodge explain the benefits of catch and release while battling extreme weather warnings on their way to becoming Master Anglers

programme.title: Fur Buying Event
programme.desc: Join Kent Maitland and fellow trappers as he inspects, grades and purchases, shed antlers and prime pelts

programme.title: North Carolina Buck
programme.desc: his week we join John \"JBone\" Rowland. You won't believe the buck that he harvests right outside of Charlotte, North Carolina.

programme.title: Rob Evans Memorial Bear Hunt - Part 1
programme.desc: Hosts Gary Bartels and Steve Holden take OATH heroes Master Sergeant Gilberto Tony Roman and Marine veteran Dave Kochmanski to Canada to hunt black bears with Harvest Lodge Outfitters for the inaugural Rob Evans Memorial Bear Hunt.

programme.title: Adventure Day
programme.desc: The Trekkit Crew takes a bunch of first time ATV riders out on brand new Segway ATVs and SxS and have them experience riding the trails. The trip ranges from getting stuck in the mud, rock climbs, and scenic trails

programme.title: Hunting Mule Deer - Part 1
programme.desc: Watch this week as Ted, Amber and country music singer Heath Sanders go to hunt mule deer in Texas

programme.title: African Adventure
programme.desc: The Ultimate OATH joins veteran Tim Crawford in South Africa with Cheetah Safaris for a bucket list safari hunt

programme.title: The Show
programme.desc: Producer Eric Orton travels remote logging roads to witness extreme hatchery operations with Steve Lacasse, Debbie Anderson, and husband Grant Anderson on Northern Vancouver Island

programme.title: A Trick or Two for Bass
programme.desc: Today’s destination takes Charlie up to the Land O’ Lakes area of Eastern Ontario for smallmouth bass. Charlie joins up with friend Chris McMillan as the two enjoy a day of bass fishing. The two share techniques for clear water lakes

programme.title: Kettle Falls Walleye
programme.desc: Bob Loomis and Britton Ransford join Rich Harrod on a walleye fishing adventure to the upper reach of Lake Roosevelt. The fish are numerous and the bite is on in this beautiful part of the Columbia River

programme.title: The Gateway
programme.desc: The Gateway is fed by ancient glacier rivers with an abundance of sockeye salmon and the predators that feed on them. Eric Orton talks about his time off-shore fishing Port Hardy

programme.title: The Reason for Monster Whitetails
programme.desc: This week we're hunting with our good friends from The Reason as they head out to try and get some monster whitetails.

programme.title: YouTube Hog Hunt Special
programme.desc: Today we're doing something a little different, we're giving you a little history on our YouTube channel and showing some of our favorite posts. Then, we’ll show three of our best hog hunts that have never aired anywhere but YouTube

programme.title: Monster Whitetails of Ohio
programme.desc: John & Beth head to Ohio with the owners of Black Widow Deer Lures, Andy & Janice. Janice harvests her first monster buck and Beth opts for a doe to collect some venison to punch her tag.

programme.title: Hog & Coyote Hunting
programme.desc: John and Sean Casey help out a farmer who is having a problem with wild hogs, then it's coyote time!

programme.title: Dacre Part II & Mud Fest
programme.desc: Find out how the team finished at the Dacre and then they head to Mirimachi Mud Fest 2023

programme.title: Hunting Mule Deer - Part 2
programme.desc: Ted and country music singer, Heath Sanders chase mule deer and then it’s off to do some airgun hunting on some Texas deer!

programme.title: Passing on a Hunting Traditon
programme.desc: The Martin fathers are teaching their daughters and sons to hunt elk in the juniper country of eastern Oregon. Horses helped the family get to the high ground where elusive bulls could be found, but the ride doesn’t guarantee success

programme.title: Elk Fever
programme.desc: This week, we join Gerry Rightmyer as he goes on the elk hunt of a lifetime, finally getting drawn after 16 years.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Join five time UFC Champ, Tim Sylvia, in the outdoors hunting and fishing

programme.title: Hog Wild
programme.desc: Gary Bartels and Steve Holden take OATH registered heroes Clint Kelly and Terrance Flemons to Rock Water Ranch in Texas to do population control on hog

programme.title: Cowboy Like You've Never Seen
programme.desc: Yes sir, Capt. Ed trades his Cuban coffee for some South Texas joe as Capt. Scott Null shows the Florida angler the saltier side of Texas.

programme.title: Swamp Hogs & Mickey Gilley Dedication
programme.desc: We join Keith on a thermal hog hunt, later he introduces us to his friend Shannon Tracy from UVC Powersports as both Shannon and Keith talk about the life and career of country music legend, Mickey Gilley

programme.title: Archery Buck
programme.desc: We join Dane as he harvests his biggest buck with a bow, and what makes this even more special is that his father JD is behind the camera

programme.title: Carolina Dreamin'
programme.desc: This week, Steve Schicker travels to South Carolina to hunt with Pete Gutowski of Uslide Bowholder, this time for deer.

programme.title: New Brunswick Bear Hunt - Part 1
programme.desc: This week the Forever Wild Outdoors cameras are filming in beautiful New Brunswick for black bear with outfitter Ben Savior.

programme.title: The Clam" Before the Storm"
programme.desc: Capt. Ed Zyak is joined by long time TV host and Banana River native Capt. Blair Wiggins to visit Blair's home waters to find the famed flats unrecognizable. Human impact and runoff have taken their toll, but Capt. Blair and others have a plan.

programme.title: Hooked on Lake Trout and Untouched Walleye
programme.desc: Today’s destination is Cree Lake in Northern Saskatchewan. Check out Charlie’s tip on modifying your tackle for large lake trout. Then, off for an often ignored walleye bite that will have you wanting more

programme.title: Kokanee Springs Escape
programme.desc: Jason tees off as Blair runs the cart and the boys explore Crawford Bay, BC and Kokanee Springs Resort

programme.title: Filling the Freezer
programme.desc: After a long 8 weeks the meat birds are finally ready for the freezer. Family and friends band together and join Ben & Nicole as they slaughter whats left of their chickens in hopes of being able to feed both them and Bens parents for the winter

programme.title: Cold November Set Up
programme.desc: Scott heads down to Valley Firearms to buy a compact dispatch rifle for the snowmobile. Then he hangs a lynx set and sets up the line on a cold November start to the season

programme.title: New Brunswick Moose
programme.desc: This week, while Pierre is in Newfoundland, we go to New Brunswick to hunt some moose with JLR Trophy Bear Hunting

programme.title: Sunny Skies Where the Dove Dies
programme.desc: Loaded with Kent shells we hunt a few different locations and share some tips on what to look for when you want to get out and sharpen your skills before the waterfowl season

programme.title: Wood Day on the Trapline
programme.desc: It's wood day out on the trapline, and Rich and Sandi put some of the newly fire killed trees to good use. Then it’s off to check lynx and otter traps from last winter.

programme.title: Coastal River Chinook Salmon
programme.desc: Casting spinners and jigs for BC river chinook salmon

programme.title: Chasin' Whitetails: Manitoba Whitetail Deer
programme.desc: Join Troy Esau on an exciting journey as he tracks elusive mature whitetail deer throughout the Manitoba hunting season.

programme.title: Winter Woes
programme.desc: Ben and Nicole have committed to a goal of self-sufficiency. Unfortunately, its proving harder than they thought. Homesteading isnt as glamourous as it may look online. Atlantic Canadian winters are proving more difficult than ever before

programme.title: Logan's Bear Blanket
programme.desc: Logan turns this bear into a rug

programme.title: Fly Fishing the Grand Cascapedia
programme.desc: This week, Pierre and his buddy Pat are in Gaspesie, Quebec for some fly fishing at the legendary Grand Cascapedia River.

programme.title: The Midwest
programme.desc: his week Heath & Brandon head to the Midwest in pursuit of giant whitetails

programme.title: Cold Weather Ducks
programme.desc: Mario heads east to a few different states and ends up in Wyoming at the Weatherby Facility for a tour. To cap things off we get to head out on the river for a very cold and snowy mallard hunt, with a small side of honkers to enjoy.

programme.title: Nighttime Raccoon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads over to their friends at Jank's Pheasant Farm. They are having serious issues with raccoons killing their pheasants. So the guys do a a night time raccoon hunt in exchange for a little pheasant hunting

programme.title: Hog Hunts and a Big Ten Point
